Prince Thaddeus slew 100 dragons.  
Prince Arthur slew three quarters as many dragons as Prince Thaddeus, so he slew $ \frac{3}{4} \times 100 = 75 $ dragons.  
Prince Walter slew twice as many dragons as Prince Arthur, so he slew $ 2 \times 75 = 150 $ dragons.  
Prince Bruce slew one-fifth as many dragons as Prince Walter, so he slew $ \frac{1}{5} \times 150 = 30 $ dragons.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 30
